Subject: Supplier intake: kickoff & checklist (Talon Parts)

Hi Nisha —

Welcome — thanks for partnering with Redwood. I’m Soojin on Procurement and I’ll be your intake lead for vendor setup. To get Talon Parts into our systems and issue a PO we typically need the items below. I’ve attached our supplier intake form to this thread (RI_Supplier_Intake_Form.pdf).

What we need from you:
- Completed supplier intake form (attached)
- W-9 or local tax form (PDF)
- Bank details for ACH / wire (bank name, routing, account number)
- Certificate of Insurance (if applicable)
- Primary billing contact (name + email + phone)

What we’ll do on our side:
- Create vendor record in our procurement portal
- Validate bank/W-9 and run compliance check (2–3 business days)
- Send DocuSign for our vendor agreement (if not already signed)
- Issue PO once onboarding completes (estimated 3 business days after validation)

Questions for you: Do you prefer ACH or wire for payments? Also confirm the billing contact we should use.

Next steps: Please fill and return the attached intake form and your W-9/bank details. Marissa (cc’d) will own the vendor profile creation; Karthik is on payments/terms if any questions.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

Hi Nisha —

Quick answers while Soojin is out of the office later this week:
- PO format: Our POs come from our ERP and include a 10-character PO number (example: PO2025-1173). We’ll send the actual PO PDF to the billing email on file.
- Security questionnaire: that’s a separate intake — if you received an email from security@redwood.com please complete it; otherwise we’ll share the link. It typically takes 1–2 business days.
- Payment methods: ACH is preferred; we also support domestic wire. International vendors may need SWIFT.

I attached: Procurement_PO_Specs.pdf (sample PO and invoicing field mapping) and re-attached the supplier intake form. Once we have your completed intake + W-9 + bank details we’ll create the vendor record.

Thanks —
